# Environment configuration reference

<!-- Generated by tools/build_code_reference.py; edit source docstrings or the generator. -->

Field names/types/default declarations come from Settings source. No runtime values or .env files are read. Environment variables use NURSE_NG_ plus the upper-case field name. Validation may normalize a value or require explicit production configuration; a source default is not a production recommendation.

Return to the [documentation index](../README.md) or [code guide](../CODE_GUIDE.md).

Read [hosting setup](../HOSTING.md) before choosing production values. Settings are cached; restart every affected process after changing them.
